platform: Europe PMC REST (searchPOST), browser; Embase via CKN
purpose: Targeted sweeps requested by Brendan on 2026-11-10: ketogenic/metabolic triggers, and temporal-lobe (especially right-sided) lesions.

blocks.src: (SRC:MED OR SRC:PMC OR SRC:PPR) NOT TITLE:(rat OR rats OR mice OR mouse OR rodent OR rodents)
blocks.E: (PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" OR PUB_TYPE:"Letter" OR TITLE_ABS:("case report" OR "a case of" OR "we report" OR "we describe" OR "we present" OR "a patient" OR "case series" OR "single case" OR "year-old"))
blocks.K_keto: TITLE_ABS:(ketogenic OR ketosis OR "ketone ester" OR "exogenous ketone" OR "beta-hydroxybutyrate" OR "low-carbohydrate" OR "low carbohydrate" OR "very low carbohydrate" OR carnivore OR "modified Atkins" OR "Atkins diet" OR "medium-chain triglyceride" OR "intermittent fasting" OR "therapeutic fasting" OR "metabolic therapy" OR "metabolic psychiatry")
blocks.T_temporal: TITLE_ABS:(lobectomy OR "temporal lobe resection" OR "temporal resection" OR amygdalohippocampectomy OR "amygdalectomy" OR "temporal lobe surgery" OR "epilepsy surgery" OR "temporal lobe lesion" OR "temporal lesion" OR "temporal lobe damage" OR "right temporal" OR "right hemisphere" OR "right hemispheric" OR "temporal lobe infarct" OR "temporal haemorrhage" OR "temporal hemorrhage")
blocks.T_left: TITLE_ABS:("left temporal" OR "left hemisphere" OR "left hemispheric" OR "dominant temporal" OR "dominant hemisphere")

EPMC_keto_cases_v1.string: src AND A2 AND K_keto AND E

EPMC_keto_trials_v1.string: src AND A2 AND K_keto AND trial terms (exact trial block not retained)
EPMC_keto_trials_v1.note: Reconstruction with (PUB_TYPE:"Randomized Controlled Trial" OR PUB_TYPE:"Clinical Trial") returns 49 on 2026-11-10. Trials are excluded as cases (E5) and linked as downstream evidence.

EPMC_temporal_v1.string: src AND A2 AND T_temporal AND B2 AND E

EMB_keto_v1.string: Embase: ketogenic/ketosis terms AND psychiatric terms (exact string not retained)
EMB_keto_v1.note: Too broad: 'ketosis' pulled in diabetic and alcoholic ketoacidosis.

EPMC_temporal_left_v1_3.string: src AND A2 AND T_left AND B2 AND E NOT T_temporal
EPMC_temporal_left_v1_3.note: The left-sided complement of EPMC_temporal_v1; together they give the symmetric set (852 on 2026-11-10). T_temporal has no 'non-dominant' terms, so 'dominant' here slightly favours the left.

known_problems: Fixed 2026-11-10 by EPMC_temporal_left_v1_3. T_temporal's neutral terms (lobectomy, epilepsy surgery, temporal lesion) already caught both sides.
K_keto 'ketosis' should be ketogenic-context only in Embase (e.g. 'nutritional ketosis'), not bare 'ketosis'.
